help.intro:
**Misaka**

Use /commands to browse the 18 registered commands, filtered by access. Six native modules are available: aliases, RSS, currency conversion, weather, stickers and subscription URL generation. /rss manages subscriptions, /rate converts currencies, and /weather queries cities or districts. /sticker converts stickers or downloads original packs; /subconv opens your own URL-generation panel. Both are private-chat only and need no administrator role. Subscription conversion itself runs on your chosen backend when you use the URL. Shuo (status posts) and AI remain to be migrated. Reminders are deferred until grammY supports Bot API 10.4 Widgets.
help.table:
**Getting started**

| Task | Entry point |
| --- | --- |
| Browse the 18 registered commands, filtered by access | /commands |
| Choose your language | /settings in private chat |
| Check the six native modules | /modules |
| Convert stickers or download original packs (everyone) | /sticker in private chat only |
| Generate a subscription conversion URL (everyone) | /subconv in private chat only |
| Manage command aliases (superadministrators) | /alias in private chat |
help.adminPrivate:
**Administration**

Use /stats for runtime status, /addgroup with a group ID to authorize it, /listgroups for paginated authorization management, and /alias to manage command aliases.
help.adminGroup:
**Group authorization**

As a configured superadministrator, you can authorize the current group with /addgroup. Open a private chat for other administration.

rate.title: Currency conversion
rate.usage:
Provide source and target currencies, with an optional amount at the start or end (default: 1). Currency codes, country names and common names are supported; natural sentences are not parsed.
/rate 100 jp rmb
/rate JPY CNY 100
/rate 100 yen yuan
/rate BTC USD
rate.chooseFrom: Amount {{amount}}: choose the source currency. Ambiguous names and symbols are never guessed.
rate.chooseTo: Amount {{amount}}: choose the target currency. Ambiguous names and symbols are never guessed.
rate.stale: Cached data is shown because refresh failed. Check the update time.
rate.disclaimer: Indicative only, not an executable trading or bank quote. Update frequency is set by the provider. Crypto and fiat use independent sources.
rate.QUERY: Use explicit arguments, for example /rate 100 JPY CNY. Natural sentences are not parsed.
rate.AMOUNT: The amount is invalid or contains extra text. Non-negative decimals and scales such as k or 万 are supported; expressions are not evaluated.
rate.CURRENCY: Specify two recognizable currencies, for example /rate 100 JPY CNY, or open the currency directory.

weather.title: Weather
weather.choose: Several locations matched. Check the country, region, city and district before choosing.
weather.notFound: No precise location matched. Include the city and district; the query will not silently switch to the city centre.
weather.input: Enter a city or district, such as Beijing Haidian or Tokyo Shinjuku. You may also voluntarily share a location using Telegram attachments. Use /cancel to cancel.
weather.privacy: GPS, IP, phone number and address are not read automatically. Queries do not save a default. Saving requires an explicit private-chat action; coordinates retain two decimal places and can be cleared.
weather.privateDefault: Your personal default is read and changed only in private chat. Specify a location for group queries.
weather.current:
{{condition}}
🌡️ Temperature: {{temperature}} °C
{{feelsIcon}} Feels like: {{feelsLike}} °C ({{feelsLabel}})
💧 Humidity: {{humidity}}%
🌬️ Wind: {{wind}} km/h
🌧️ Precipitation: {{rain}} mm
weather.model: Current values are model estimates, not necessarily on-site observations.
weather.fallback: The primary service is unavailable; a fallback provider is shown.
weather.resolution: District matching does not imply separate observations at every point. Weather resolution depends on the provider.
weather.saved: Default location saved for your private-chat queries only.

sticker.title: Sticker conversion
sticker.usage:
In private chat, send a sticker or reply to one with /sticker.
Choose image/animation or file, then a format. Send a pack link for an original-file ZIP. /cancel stops processing.
sticker.animationHint: GIF keeps animation; PNG exports the first frame.
sticker.packLimit: Original-file ZIP: up to 120 items / 20 MiB.
sticker.invalid: This sticker, pack or output is unsupported, invalid or exceeds a safety limit. Send a supported sticker or pack link; arbitrary files are not accepted.
sticker.unavailable: The source or conversion service is unavailable. Video conversion requires ffmpeg with VP9 support; an available original can still be downloaded without it.
sticker.uncertain: Telegram's upload result could not be confirmed. The file may already have arrived; check the chat before trying again. It will not be sent again automatically.
sticker.capacity: The source or processing limit has been reached. Wait for a job or panel to finish, or use /cancel to release your panels and stop processing.
sticker.expired: This panel expired. Send the sticker or pack link again.
sticker.cancelled: Cancelled. Files already sent are not recalled.

subconv.title: Subscription URL generation
subconv.disclosure: URL generation only: the bot does not fetch or convert subscriptions. Using the URL sends raw subscriptions and parameters to your chosen backend. Keep bearer links private.
subconv.scvWarning: Warning: scv is enabled by default in this fork. It skips TLS certificate verification in generated node configurations, NOT in the bot. Disable it if not needed.
subconv.scvUnknown: The custom scv value is unrecognized. Check your backend's generated-node TLS behavior before use; do not assume verification is enabled or skipped. Bot TLS verification is unchanged.
subconv.copyHint: Copy the complete URL from the code block into your own client. It may remain in Telegram history; do not share it.
subconv.cancelled: Panel cancelled. Temporary inputs were cleared; saved preferences and Telegram history are unchanged.
subconv.expired: Panel expired. Open /subconv again and re-enter temporary inputs; saved preferences remain.
subconv.inputHint: Reply to the matching ForceReply prompt, not as a new message. Back cancels input; Clear removes this field; /cancel closes the panel. Sources: one per line. Custom parameters: name=value per line.
subconv.invalidInput: Check {{field}}: it is missing, invalid or over the limit. No input value is shown.

rss.title: RSS subscriptions ({{count}})
rss.description: Subscriptions belong to this chat and topic. Group administrators or superadministrators manage group subscriptions. New subscriptions skip existing items and default to silent notifications. Expand RSS content inside messages or open the original link.
rss.empty: No subscriptions yet. Add an RSS or Atom URL below.
rss.input:
Send an RSS or Atom URL, optionally followed by a space and custom title.
Use /cancel to cancel.
rss.usage:
Use /rss to open subscription management.
/rss add <URL> [title]
/rss remove <ID>
/rss mute <ID> on|off
/rss pause <ID> on|off
rss.added: Subscription saved. Existing items form the baseline; only newly discovered items will be sent.
rss.removed: Unsubscribed. Unsent deliveries have been cancelled.
rss.imagesUnavailable: Images could not be embedded. Open the original images below:
rss.unhealthy: RSS retrieval has failed repeatedly. Automatic retries will back off.

errors.UNSAFE_URL: Only public HTTP/HTTPS feeds are supported. Private networks, custom ports and URLs with credentials are not allowed.
errors.BLOCKED: The site denied access or returned a login/browser verification page instead of RSS. Browser access does not imply bot access; a directly readable feed or site-authorized access method is required.
errors.HTTP_ERROR: The feed returned an HTTP error. Check the URL or try again later.
errors.INVALID_FEED: The response is not valid RSS/Atom or contains unsupported XML structure.
errors.TOO_LARGE: The feed response exceeds the safe size limit.
errors.TIMEOUT: The feed request timed out. Try again later.
errors.NETWORK: Could not connect to the feed site. Try again later.

deliveryErrors.BLOCKED: Telegram denied delivery. Notifications are paused; check that the bot is not blocked or removed before resuming.
deliveryErrors.REJECTED: Telegram rejected a message. It was not automatically resent.
deliveryErrors.UNKNOWN: Some delivery outcomes are unknown. They will not be automatically retried, to avoid duplicate notifications.

alias.title: Command aliases
alias.description: Aliases use the original command's permissions. Entries show the original command -> aliases. Only configured superadministrators can manage aliases, in private chat.
alias.input: Send one alias for /{{command}}, without /, spaces, or arguments. /cancel cancels.
alias.invalidName: Use letters, numbers, or underscores, up to 32 characters. Do not include /, spaces, or arguments.
alias.unknownCommand: Choose a registered original command, not another alias.
alias.collision: This name is already a command or an alias for another command. Choose a different name.
alias.changed: Aliases changed elsewhere. Review the latest list before trying again.
alias.usage:
/alias
/alias add help guide
/alias remove help guide

cancelled: Forms and non-approval panels in this user/chat/topic context have been cleared, and sticker processing has been aborted. Already delivered files are not recalled. Approval buttons have a separate expiry and are not revoked by /cancel.
privateOnly: Use this command in a private chat with the bot.
unknownCommand: Unknown command. Use /help to see the available commands.
fallback: Use /help for commands. Natural-language AI is not connected.
expired: This button is expired, unavailable, or from an older version. Reopen a fresh panel or run /commands, /settings, /addgroup, /listgroups or /alias again.
outputTooLong: This result is too long to send. Use a smaller page or restart the command.

groups.usage: In private chat: /addgroup -1001234567890. In a group: /addgroup authorizes only the current group.
groups.waiting: This group is not authorized. The bot will try to notify its superadministrators and stay silent until approved; it will not leave on a timer.
groups.adminGuide: This group is not authorized. You are a configured superadministrator: send /addgroup or /addgroup@{{username}} to authorize this group. Existing groups are not automatically authorized when the bot restarts. Use a private chat for settings and other administration.
groups.authorized: This group is authorized. Use /help for available core commands.
groups.revoked: Authorization has been revoked. The bot will no longer process this group's commands and will try to leave.
